name: Meross Matter Smart Wi-Fi Plug Mini (MSS115)

radios.note: Needs an existing 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.

matter.note: Meross sells it as a Matter plug. CSA lists several Meross 'Smart Plug Mini' Matter certificates, but we could not match one to the MSS115 model number.

apple_home.note: Through Matter; needs an Apple home hub.

google_home.note: Through Matter; needs a Google Matter controller.

alexa.note: Through Matter. We could not confirm whether the Meross Alexa skill also supports this model.

smartthings.note: Through Matter; needs a SmartThings hub.

home_assistant.note: Should pair through the Home Assistant Matter integration, but neither Meross nor Home Assistant names this model, and forum users report failed Matter pairing.

hubRequired.note: Meross does not say whether the Meross app alone can run it without a Matter controller.

localControl.note: Meross describes it as fully local over Matter and says it keeps working on the LAN during internet outages.

energyMonitoring.note: The MSS115 pages don't mention a power meter. Meross's metering Matter plug is the MSS315, but we found no explicit 'no metering' statement for the MSS115.

maxLoadWatts.note: We found no official MSS115 load rating. The 15 A / 1800 W figure Meross gives is for other plug models.

summary: The Meross MSS115 is a compact US/Canada Wi-Fi smart plug that works through Matter. Meross lists Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings, and it can join several of them at once. It runs on 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Meross says it works locally without the cloud.
caveats: Each ecosystem needs its own Matter controller, such as a HomePod, Apple TV, Nest hub, Echo or SmartThings hub.
Matter setup needs iOS 16.1 or later, or Android 8.1 or later.
